description: Define/reuse provider-scoped disconnect eligibility with canonical provider IDs and the existing non-finalized state semantics, preserving credential tombstones.
Scheduled accounting ticks skip only blocked providers and process every connected target of each eligible provider, including when blocked-provider credentials are absent.
Sync Now checks only the intended provider's disconnect state and retains actionable feedback when its credentials are tombstoned.
Invoice sync enqueue checks only the intended provider and writes no export operation for a blocked provider.
Drift re-export checks only the intended provider and preserves provider/organisation identity on queued work.
Explicit blocked or missing provider/organisation selections never fall back to another target; permissions and tenant boundaries remain enforced.
Healthy-provider cycles resume without clearing the other provider's disconnect record, and a new actual result replaces the historical error while retaining history.
Retain both-blocked/no-target no-op behavior, finalized/no-record eligibility, multi-target execution, CE gating, and automatic-sync settings.
